retrievalProfile.description: A surreal portrait featuring a human subject integrated with celestial elements like planetary rings and starfield textures against a textured gold backdrop.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait where the subject's lower face and torso are replaced by a dense starfield, bisected by a polished gold planetary ring that frames the eyes, set against a uniform gold glitter texture.
coreVisualRelationships: The gold ring acts as a physical barrier between the realistic eyes and the cosmic lower body.
The starfield texture within the ring matches the texture of the subject's torso.
The high-contrast gold background emphasizes the dark silhouette of the subject.
The handwritten script at the top balances the weight of the centered portrait.
coreInvariants: Polished metallic ring framing the eyes
Starfield/nebula texture overlay on the body

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered bust-up portrait occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, framed tightly by the upper curve of the gold ring.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the gold ring's ellipse, moves down to the starfield torso, and ends at the top script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform gold glitter texture surrounding the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value gold vs. low value black creates a silhouette effect with high-saturation point-light accents.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight with ink-bleed edges
Ascenders and descenders are elongated and pointed
Connected lowercase letters with a detached, large initial
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter features a cross-stroke that extends beyond the character width
Terminal strokes end in sharp, needle-like points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script paired with a complex visual image.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, energetic feel of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with black hair against a gold glitter background. Replace the lower face and torso with a dark starfield texture. Add a polished gold ring that encircles the head at eye level, appearing to pass through the head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a black, sharp, handwritten script at the top center using a vector brush tool to maintain the aggressive gestural quality.

verificationChecks: Is the gold ring perfectly elliptical and polished?
Does the starfield texture blend seamlessly into the subject's silhouette?
Is the background a consistent gold glitter texture?
Is the text sharp and gestural?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold glitter background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of the ring and starfield
High-quality metallic sheen on the ring
Uniform glitter texture without tiling artifacts
avoid: Flat yellow instead of metallic gold
Generic computer fonts for the script

postGenerationChecks: The ring must appear to wrap around the head, not just sit on top.
The eyes must be the only realistic skin-tone element visible.
The starfield must contain varied colors (red, blue, white).
The script must be legible but expressive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Celestial Element] using [Metallic Texture] and [Starfield Overlay] against a [Glitter Background] with [Sharp Script] typography.
